- **Living Room Wall:** I have a move-in photo (12 Mar 2024) and a move-out photo (30 Oct 2026).
- **Bathroom:** I have a move-out photo (30 Oct 2026), but no dated move-in photo.

I will create an album named "Move-out Proof deposit evidence" and a folder "Deposit_Evidence" in "Documents/Tenancy" containing the report "move-out-proof-report". Would you like me to also include copies of the paired photos in that folder?

Please review and approve this plan.
